svg.title: Diagram 4. Genie ask and poll (UC2) and send context to Genie (UC3): MCP session, guardrails, queue and caps, serial polls, outcomes, ContextGate and UC Pages drafts
svg.desc: Part 1 (UC2): R8 initialises the Genie One MCP session (protocol 2025-06-18, Mcp-Session-Id, tools/list) and re-initialises once on a 404 with a session. The main agent asks through AgentGuard: in-flight caps of 2 per MOG, 4 per profile and 1 per conversation, and a per-conversation FIFO queue of max 3 with a busy chip. genie_ask carries warehouse_id in _meta on the polling path. Polls are serial on the D31/D55 cadence. Outcomes: completed blurb with Open in Databricks, incomplete as Partial answer or failure, needs_input clarify, cancel and give-up. Part 2 (UC3): the ContextAssembler filters and PII-scrubs at most 5 items into a preamble of 800 chars or less, the user previews it before the first send, the ContextGate binds the approval to payload, target, conversation and attempt, the card shows context included N chars, a POLICY_DENIED resend goes once without the preamble, and later turns send new items only. Approved definitions become the user DRAFT UC Pages.
svg.text: Diagram 4. Genie ask and poll (UC2) and send context to Genie (UC3), genie_one_mcp backend
Part 1. UC2 ask and poll. The agent calls the Genie tools; R8 enforces every rule. Without an agent, T8/T9 make the same calls.
